grades.quote: When the status is Initial, the corresponding state should have an initial constant value.
grades.reason: Gives the general rule for extension context status fields (FS, VS, XS): Initial means the state should hold an initial constant value, and on restore it is set to that constant without memory access. It does not state the floating-point case explicitly, because the floating-point example is cut off.
Describes the F extension register state (f0-f31 and fcsr). It says nothing about the FS field or the Initial state, and nothing about what happens to register contents.
Covers BF16 exception handling and flags. It is unrelated to FS or Initial state.
Covers the vector status field VS, not FS, and does not describe the effect on floating-point register contents. It only says VS is defined analogously to FS.
